title: Classic Italian Meatballs
instructions: In a large bowl, combine ground beef, breadcrumbs, egg, parmesan, garlic, parsley, salt, and pepper.
Form mixture into 1.5-inch meatballs.
Brown meatballs in a skillet over medium-high heat for 6-8 minutes.
Add marinara sauce, reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 20 minutes.

title: Bakery Style Chocolate Chip Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees F.
Whisk flour, baking soda, and salt in a small bowl.
Beat butter, brown sugar, granulated sugar, and vanilla in a large bowl until creamy.
Add eggs one at a time, beating well after each addition.
Gradually blend in flour mixture, then fold in chocolate chips.
Drop rounded tablespoons onto ungreased baking sheets and bake for 9 to 11 minutes.

title: Spicy Dan Dan Pork Noodles
instructions: Cook noodles according to package instructions, drain and set aside.
In a wok or skillet, brown ground pork with garlic over high heat.
Stir in chili crisp oil, soy sauce, sesame oil, and tahini.
Pour in chicken broth and simmer for 5 minutes.
Ladle sauce and pork over cooked noodles, garnish with sliced scallions.

title: Traditional Basil Pine Nut Pesto
instructions: Combine basil, pine nuts, and garlic in a food processor and pulse until coarsely chopped.
Slowly drizzle in olive oil while processor is running on low.
Transfer to a bowl and stir in grated parmesan and salt.

title: Homestyle Ground Beef & Tomato Skillet
instructions: Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat and brown the ground beef.
Add diced onion and cook until translucent, about 5 minutes.
Stir in diced tomatoes, oregano, garlic powder, salt, and pepper.
Simmer for 10-12 minutes until tomatoes break down into a thick sauce.

title: Classic Backyard Cheeseburgers
instructions: Gently mix ground beef with worcestershire sauce, garlic powder, salt, and pepper.
Form into 4 equal patties with a slight depression in the center.
Grill on high heat for 4 minutes per side.
Top with cheddar cheese during the last minute of cooking, serve on toasted brioche buns.
